name: VA-accredited attorneys and claims agents per veteran, by state, with county counts and Board of Veterans' Appeals outcomes by type of representation
description: How many attorneys and claims agents the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs has accredited to help with benefit claims, counted by the state (and, in the county file, the county) of each person's business address, against the VA's own projection of living veterans (VetPop2023, rounded to the nearest 1,000). One record per state, DC, Puerto Rico and territory, one for the United States and one for people whose list entry shows no US state, each with attorneys, claims agents, veterans per accredited attorney, accredited attorneys and agents per 100,000 veterans, the number accredited in the last 12 months and how many counties have none. Records for the Board of Veterans' Appeals add its decisions in fiscal year 2024 by outcome and by type of representative. The VA's lists name every person; only counts are read, and no name, phone number, registration number or ZIP code is published.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). VA-accredited attorneys and claims agents per veteran, by state, with county counts and Board of Veterans' Appeals outcomes by type of representation (Version 2.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24116062

distribution.name: veterans-representation.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: veterans-representation.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: veterans-representation-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in veterans-representation-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to veterans-representation.csv on id.

recordSet.name: veterans-representation
recordSet.description: The records of VA-accredited attorneys and claims agents per veteran, by state, with county counts and Board of Veterans' Appeals outcomes by type of representation, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter code of the state, DC or territory; US for the United States and the Board's rows; OTHER for people whose list entry shows a blank, military, foreign or unrecognised state

field.name: areaType
field.description: us, state, dc, territory, other, or bva (a Board of Veterans' Appeals row)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: value
field.description: Accredited attorneys plus accredited claims agents (the people on the VA lists); for a bva row, the Board's decisions in that row

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
